segments.cap: I just set up Saturday's foam party for a customer. Watch what happens when she books.
She picks the Foam Party Deluxe right from my booking page.
The second she submits, the deposit invoice goes out on its own.
Then the waiver. She signs it right on her phone.
My crew gets a text with the address, the time, and the gear list.
And all three dots go green. That party is ready to run.
That's the whole admin side of a party. Rally your crew, run your day.
